statements.label: art:admissible
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Actual-gradient, nonzero-gradient infinite full-BFGS run in positive finite dimension; no existence of acceptable points on every ray.

statements.label: art:run-invariants
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Positive definiteness, curvature and predicted-decrease bounds derived, not assumed at later iterates.

statements.label: art:reference-energy
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Arbitrary reference for identity; optimizer hypothesis only for objective-gap bound.

statements.label: art:minor-hierarchy
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Actual principal determinant sums; SPD H, alpha>0,q>0,beta>0,1<=j<=n. Positive dimension is a harmless article specialization.

statements.label: art:gram-compression
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Explicit Schur/rank-two calculation supporting the actual-matrix theorem; no assumed scalar hierarchy.

statements.label: art:reciprocal-growth
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Bounded accepted gradients, fixed positive lower beta bound and predicted decrease tending to zero; no matrix/iterate convergence. Article uses qualitative result; finite-horizon and superquadratic results remain in companion.

statements.label: art:band-certificate
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: PSD finite-valued field on differentiable points of each compact positive band; all sufficiently small eligible pairs. No continuity, uniform bound or coercivity of field. Article normalizes the secant constant to C>=0 without loss by replacing C with max(C,0), explicitly stated after the definition.

statements.label: art:certificate
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Compact sublevel, attained minimum, actual admissible run and objective band certificates. Value and distance converge; uniqueness only for whole iterates. Article uses the separately proved O(N) scalar transport estimate and qualitative contradiction; principal formal target uses the harmless O(N^2) enlargement and superquadratic theorem.

statements.label: art:radial-equivalence
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Same compact sublevel K={F<=b}, b>Fstar. RS is required on all descending differentiable pairs with t>0, not just eligible pairs; inward sampled point may be nondifferentiable.

statements.label: art:radial-convergence
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Radial field rr^T supplies visible secant and exact transport. Compactness and a minimizer retained; uniqueness only for iterate limit.

statements.label: art:centered
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Convex locally C1,1 smooth summand on open convex neighborhood of compact initial sublevel, finite convex degree-one sublinear summand, minimizer at chosen center. Neither summand separately minimized there. Article proof uses inward Taylor route; formal principal theorem uses cocoercivity/correction bound.

statements.label: art:localization
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Finite convex full-space objective with unique attained minimizer; a common low sublevel lies in prescribed neighborhood, independent of initialization matrix.

statements.label: art:polyhedral
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Article retains full-dimensional finite closed polyhedral cover from corrected prose; formal theorem is stronger and does not require full dimensionality. Separate smooth extension neighborhoods are shrunk after discarding nonincident cells; only F must be convex.

statements.label: art:plq
statements.hypothesis_and_proof_correspondence: Finite convex PLQ defined by polyhedral cells, with unique minimizer; finite maxima of arbitrary quadratic branches are not automatically included. The article defines PLQ using full-dimensional closed cells, matching its retained headline specialization.

BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun.source_excerpt:
/-- Infinite accepted, nonstationary full-BFGS run with ordinary Armijo and
weak Wolfe. This specification does not assert all-ray line-search existence. -/
structure AdmissibleBFGSRun (n : ℕ) (F : Vec n → ℝ) where
  convex : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F
  x : ℕ → Vec n
  H : ℕ → Mat n
  g : ℕ → Vec n
  α : ℕ → ℝ
  c₁ : ℝ
  c₂ : ℝ
  c₁_pos : 0 < c₁
  c₁_lt_c₂ : c₁ < c₂
  c₂_lt_one : c₂ < 1
  initial_posDef : (H 0).PosDef
  alpha_pos : ∀ k, 0 < α k
  gradient_nonzero : ∀ k, g k ≠ 0
  hasGradient : ∀ k, HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional (g k)) (x k)
  step : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = x k + bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k)
  update : ∀ k,
    H (k + 1) = inverseBFGS (H k) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k))
      (g (k + 1) - g k)
  armijo : ∀ k,
    F (x (k + 1)) ≤ F (x k) + c₁ * dot (g k) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k))
  weak_wolfe : ∀ k,
    c₂ * dot (g k) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k)) ≤
      dot (g (k + 1)) (bfgsStep (H k) (g k) (α k))

/-- Source M:fixedenergy for the actual inverse of each full-BFGS matrix. -/
theorem fixed_reference_energy (xstar : Vec n) (k : ℕ) :
    R.referenceEnergy xstar (k + 1) = R.referenceEnergy xstar k -
      (R.referencePairing xstar k) ^ 2 / R.q k + R.referenceCorrection xstar k := by
  have hx : R.x (k + 1) - xstar = (R.x k - xstar) + R.displacement k := by
    rw [R.step k]
    change R.x k + R.displacement k - xstar = _
    abel
  unfold referenceEnergy referencePairing referenceCorrection
  rw [R.hessian_update k, hx]
  exact EnergyIdentities.fixed_reference _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (R.annihilated_hessian_isSymm k) (R.annihilated_hessian_mul_displacement k)

/-- Source M:energybound, including the actual cumulative correction. -/
theorem fixed_reference_energy_bound (xstar : Vec n)
    (hmin : ∀ z, F xstar ≤ F z) (N : ℕ) :
    (F (R.x N) - F xstar) ^ 2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (R.q k)⁻¹) ≤
      R.referenceEnergy xstar 0 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, R.referenceCorrection xstar k :=
  EnergyBudget.gap_sq_mul_reciprocal_sum_le (R.referenceEnergy_nonneg xstar) R.q_pos
    (fun k => sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin (R.x k))) (R.gap_antitone xstar)
    (R.gap_le_referencePairing xstar) (R.fixed_reference_energy xstar) N

theorem hessian_update (k : ℕ) :
    R.hessian (k + 1) = R.hessian k - (R.q k)⁻¹ • outer (R.g k) (R.g k) +
      (R.curvature k)⁻¹ • outer (R.gradientChange k) (R.gradientChange k) := by

  rw [R.update k]
  exact hessianUpdate (R.positive_definite k) (R.gradient_nonzero k) _
    (R.alpha_pos k) (R.curvature_pos k)

BfgsVerification.CenteredSmoothConvergen.source_excerpt:
def CenteredSmoothConvergenceTarget : Prop :=
  ∀ {n : ℕ} {F ψ γ : Vec n → ℝ} (R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) (star : Vec n),
    (∀ x, F star ≤ F x) → ∀ {U : Set (Vec n)}, IsOpen U → ConvexOn ℝ U ψ →
    CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ → ConvexOn ℝ univ γ →
    Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne γ → (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + γ (x-star)) →
    IsCompact R.initialSublevel → R.initialSublevel ⊆ U →
    Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F star)) ∧
      ((∀ x, F x = F star → x = star) → Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 star))

/-- The literal finite-polyhedral-partition hypothesis, with actual affine
inequality cells and separate smooth extension neighborhoods, implies the
source's local full-BFGS convergence conclusion. Full dimensionality and
disjoint cell interiors are unnecessary for this stronger radial proof. -/
theorem finite_polyhedral_basin {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {m : ι → ℕ}
    {F : Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → Vec n) (b : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → ℝ)
    (V : ι → Set (Vec n)) (f : ι → Vec n → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i))
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (V i) (f i))
    {U : Set (Vec n)} (hU : IsOpen U) {star : Vec n} (hsU : star ∈ U)
    (hpart : ∀ i, U ∩ polyhedron (a i) (b i) ⊆ V i)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ i, x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i))
    (hrep : ∀ i x, x ∈ U → x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i) → F x = f i x)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F star ≤ F x) (hu : ∀ x, F x = F star → x = star) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F, F (R.x 0) ≤ F star+δ →
      (∀ k, R.x k ∈ U) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F star)) ∧
      Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 star) :=
  local_cells_basin hF (fun i => polyhedron (a i) (b i)) V f
    (fun i => polyhedron_closed (a i) (b i)) (fun i => polyhedron_convex (a i) (b i))
    hV hsmooth hU hsU hpart hcover hrep hmin hu

/-- A finite closed convex cell representation with separate local C1,1
extensions gives IR on every compact subset of one fixed neighborhood. Only
the full objective must be convex; extensions need not be convex off cells. -/
theorem local_cells_inward {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {F : Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (P V : ι → Set (Vec n)) (f : ι → Vec n → ℝ)
    (hPc : ∀ i, IsClosed (P i)) (hPv : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (P i))
    (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i))
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (V i) (f i))
    {U : Set (Vec n)} (hU : IsOpen U) {star : Vec n} (hsU : star ∈ U)
    (hpart : ∀ i, U ∩ P i ⊆ V i) (hcover : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ i, x ∈ P i)
    (hrep : ∀ i x, x ∈ U → x ∈ P i → F x = f i x) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ K : Set (Vec n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ Metric.ball star ε →
      RadialCertificate.HasInwardTaylorBounds F K star := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hBU,hinc,hBV⟩ := incident_neighborhood P V hPc hV hU hsU hpart
  refine ⟨ε,hε,?_⟩
  intro K hK hKB
  let J := {i : ι // star ∈ P i}
  have hsm (i : J) : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (Metric.ball star ε) (f i.val) :=
    ⟨(hsmooth i.val).1.mono (hBV i.val i.property),
      (hsmooth i.val).2.mono (hBV i.val i.property)⟩
  apply finite_incident_cells_inward hF (fun i : J => P i.val) (fun i : J => f i.val)
    (fun i => hPv i.val) (fun i => i.property) Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball star ε)
    (Metric.mem_ball_self hε) hsm hK hKB
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hcover x (hBU (hKB hx))
    exact ⟨⟨i,hinc i x (hKB hx) hi⟩,hi⟩
  · intro i x hx hxi
    exact hrep i.val x (hBU hx) hxi

/-- A finite convex piecewise linear-quadratic objective has the source local
convergence basin. All quadratic regularity is derived from its coefficients. -/
theorem piecewise_quadratic_basin {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {m : ι → ℕ}
    {F : Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ univ F)
    (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → Vec n) (b : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → ℝ)
    (Q : ι → Mat n) (c : ι → Vec n) (d : ι → ℝ)
    {U : Set (Vec n)} (hU : IsOpen U) {star : Vec n} (hsU : star ∈ U)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ i, x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i))
    (hrep : ∀ i x, x ∈ U → x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i) → F x = quadratic (Q i) (c i) (d i) x)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F star ≤ F x) (hu : ∀ x, F x = F star → x = star) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ R : AdmissibleBFGSRun n F, F (R.x 0) ≤ F star+δ →
      (∀ k, R.x k ∈ U) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) atTop (𝓝 (F star)) ∧
      Tendsto R.x atTop (𝓝 star) :=
  finite_polyhedral_basin hF a b (fun _ => univ) (fun i => quadratic (Q i) (c i) (d i))
    (fun _ => isOpen_univ) (fun i => quadratic_locallyC11 (Q i) (c i) (d i))
    hU hsU (fun _ => subset_univ _) hcover hrep hmin hu

/-- Equality on the inward cell segment identifies the radial derivative even
at a lower-dimensional cell or a nondifferentiable interface of the pieces. -/
theorem radial_derivative_eq {n : ℕ} {F f : Vec n → ℝ} {P U : Set (Vec n)}
    (hP : Convex ℝ P) (hU : Convex ℝ U) {star x g : Vec n}
    (hsP : star ∈ P) (hxP : x ∈ P) (hsU : star ∈ U) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (hrep : ∀ z ∈ U, z ∈ P → F z = f z)
    (hg : HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    dot g (x-star) = (fderiv ℝ f x) (x-star) := by
  have hcurve : HasDerivAt (fun t => RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) (-(x-star)) 0 := by
    simpa only [RadialCertificate.inwardPoint,one_smul,zero_sub] using
      ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (x-star)).const_sub x
  have hdF := hg.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hcurve (by simp [RadialCertificate.inwardPoint])
  have hdf := hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hcurve (by simp [RadialCertificate.inwardPoint])
  have heq : (fun t => F (RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)) =ᶠ[𝓝[Icc 0 1] 0]
      (fun t => f (RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    exact hrep _ (inward_mem hU hsU hxU ht) (inward_mem hP hsP hxP ht)
  have hu : UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) 0 :=
    uniqueDiffOn_Icc (by norm_num) 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  have hd := hu.eq_deriv _ hdF.hasDerivWithinAt
    (hdf.hasDerivWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq (by simpa [RadialCertificate.inwardPoint] using hrep x hxU hxP))
  simp only [gradientFunctional_apply,map_neg] at hd
  linarith

    (hψ : CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ)

    (hrep : ∀ i x, x ∈ U → x ∈ polyhedron (a i) (b i) →
      F x = ψ x+quadratic (Q i) (c i) (d i) x)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F star ≤ F x) (hu : ∀ x, F x = F star → x = star) :

    (fun _ => hU) (fun i => locallyC11_add hU hψ (hq i))

/-- Every specified neighborhood of an attained unique minimizer contains
an entire sublevel strictly above the minimum. -/
theorem neighborhood_basin {F : E → ℝ}
    (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (xStar : E)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F xStar ≤ F x)
    (hunique : ∀ x, F x = F xStar → x = xStar)
    {U : Set E} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 xStar) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ {x | F x ≤ F xStar + δ} ⊆ U := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrU⟩ := Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.mp hU
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hgap⟩ := positive_sphere_lower_gap hF xStar hmin hunique hr
  refine ⟨ω / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hsub := low_sublevel_subset_ball hF hr hω.le hgap
    (a := F xStar + ω / 2) (by linarith)
  exact hsub.trans (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hrU)

/-- An attained unique minimizer has an attained, strictly positive minimum
gap on every positive-radius sphere. Nontriviality ensures the sphere is nonempty. -/
theorem sphere_gap [Nontrivial E] {F : E → ℝ}
    (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (xStar : E)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F xStar ≤ F x)
    (hunique : ∀ x, F x = F xStar → x = xStar)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ ω : ℝ, 0 < ω ∧
      (∃ z, dist z xStar = r ∧ F z - F xStar = ω) ∧
      ∀ z, dist z xStar = r → ω ≤ F z - F xStar := by
  have hcont : Continuous F :=
    continuous_iff_continuousOn_univ.mpr (hF.continuousOn isOpen_univ)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hleast⟩ := (isCompact_sphere xStar r).exists_isMinOn
    (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr hr.le) hcont.continuousOn
  have hzdist : dist z xStar = r := hz
  have hne : z ≠ xStar := by
    intro he
    subst z
    simp at hzdist
    linarith
  have hvalue_ne : F z ≠ F xStar := fun he => hne (hunique z he)
  have hstrict : F xStar < F z := lt_of_le_of_ne (hmin z) hvalue_ne.symm
  refine ⟨F z - F xStar, sub_pos.mpr hstrict, ⟨z, hzdist, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact sub_le_sub_right (hleast hy) _

/-- Every sublevel is compact; finite convexity supplies its closedness. -/
theorem sublevel_compact {F : E → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (xStar : E)
    (hmin : ∀ x, F xStar ≤ F x)
    (hunique : ∀ x, F x = F xStar → x = xStar) (a : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {x | F x ≤ a} := by
  apply Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr
  have hcont : Continuous F :=
    continuous_iff_continuousOn_univ.mpr (hF.continuousOn isOpen_univ)
  exact ⟨isClosed_le hcont continuous_const, sublevel_bounded hF xStar hmin hunique a⟩

/-- This is M.1's desired end-to-end theorem statement, NOT a theorem proof. -/
def PrincipalMinorHierarchyTarget : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : Mat n) (g y : Vec n) (α : ℝ),
    H.PosDef → 0 < α →
    let q := metricEnergy H g
    let β := -dot y (H.mulVec g) / q

    ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n →
      principalSum (inverseBFGS H (bfgsStep H g α) y) j ≤
        sqNorm y / (β ^ 2 * q) * principalSum H (j + 1) +
        α / β * principalSum H j

      (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ u k) →
        Summable u →
          0 < m →
            0 ≤ C →
              (∀ (k : ℕ), E (k + 1) ≤ (1 + u k) * (E k - m / q k) + C) →

/-- Constant additive correction yields an actual linear reciprocal budget. -/
theorem reciprocal_sum_le {E q u : ℕ → ℝ} {m C : ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ k, 0 ≤ E k) (hq : ∀ k, 0 < q k)
    (hu : ∀ k, 0 ≤ u k) (hs : Summable u) (hm : 0 < m) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hrec : ∀ k, E (k+1) ≤ (1+u k)*(E k-m/q k)+C) (N : ℕ) :
    (m/Real.exp (∑' k, u k))*(∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (q k)⁻¹) ≤ E 0+C*(N : ℝ) := by
  let P := driftProduct u
  let B := Real.exp (∑' k, u k)
  have hPone : ∀ k, 1 ≤ P k := one_le_driftProduct hu
  have hPpos : ∀ k, 0 < P k := fun k => lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hPone k)
  have hPB : ∀ k, P k ≤ B := driftProduct_le_exp_tsum hu hs
  have hnorm : ∀ k, E (k+1)/P (k+1) ≤ E k/P k-(m/B)*(q k)⁻¹+C := by
    intro k
    have hfactor : 0 < 1+u k := by linarith [hu k]
    have hchange : ((1+u k)*(E k-m/q k)+C)/P (k+1) =
        E k/P k-(m/q k)/P k+C/P (k+1) := by
      rw [show P (k+1) = P k*(1+u k) from driftProduct_succ u k]
      field_simp [(hPpos k).ne',hfactor.ne',(hq k).ne']
      ring
    have hdes : (m/B)*(q k)⁻¹ ≤ (m/q k)/P k := by
      rw [show (m/B)*(q k)⁻¹ = (m/q k)/B by ring]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (div_nonneg hm.le (hq k).le) (hPpos k) (hPB k)
    have hadd : C/P (k+1) ≤ C := div_le_self hC (hPone (k+1))
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hrec k) (hPpos (k+1)).le
    rw [hchange] at hdiv
    linarith
  have hsum := descent_sum_le (fun k => div_nonneg (hE k) (hPpos k).le) hnorm N
  simpa only [← Finset.mul_sum,P,driftProduct_zero,div_one,B,Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_comm (N : ℝ) C] using hsum

BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate..source_excerpt:
/-- One-sided transported PSD certificate on one positive objective band.
The secant and transport conditions apply only to small eligible pairs in it. -/
structure BandCertificate {n : ℕ} (F : Vec n → ℝ) (K : Set (Vec n))
    (fstar c₁ c₂ η : ℝ) where
  W : Vec n → Mat n
  m : ℝ
  C : ℝ
  L : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  m_pos : 0 < m
  L_nonneg : 0 ≤ L
  delta_pos : 0 < δ
  positive_semidefinite : ∀ x ∈ positiveBand F K fstar η,
    DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → (W x).PosSemidef
  visibility : ∀ x ∈ positiveBand F K fstar η, ∀ g,
    HasFDerivAt F (gradientFunctional g) x → m ≤ metricEnergy (W x) g
  secant : ∀ x z g h,
    x ∈ positiveBand F K fstar η → z ∈ positiveBand F K fstar η →
    EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h → pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ →
    metricEnergy (W z) (h - g) ≤ C * pairCurvature x z g h
  transport : ∀ x z g h,
    x ∈ positiveBand F K fstar η → z ∈ positiveBand F K fstar η →
    EligiblePair F c₁ c₂ x z g h → pairDecrease x z g ≤ δ →
    ((1 + L * pairDecrease x z g) •
      (stepProjector (pairStep x z) * W x * stepProjector (pairStep x z)) -
      stepProjector (pairStep x z) * W z * stepProjector (pairStep x z)).PosSemidef

BfgsVerification.principalMinorHierarchy.source_excerpt:
/-- Module M.1 for actual principal determinants of the unmodified full
    inverse-BFGS update, in arbitrary finite dimension. -/
theorem principalMinorHierarchy : PrincipalMinorHierarchyTarget := by
  classical
  intro n H g y α hH hα
  dsimp only
  intro hq hβ j _hj1 _hjn
  let q := metricEnergy H g
  let β := -dot y (H.mulVec g) / q
  let Hplus := inverseBFGS H (bfgsStep H g α) y
  let S := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard j
  obtain ⟨U, lam, hUL, hUR, hdiag, hlam⟩ := posDef_orthogonal_diagonalization hH
  have hpoint (I : Finset (Fin n)) :
      (metricGram Hplus (U * coordinateMatrix I)).det ≤
        (metricGram H (Matrix.fromCols (Matrix.replicateCol Unit y)
          (U * coordinateMatrix I))).det / (β ^ 2 * q) +
        α / β * (metricGram H (U * coordinateMatrix I)).det :=
    BFGSCompression.compressed_inverseBFGS_bound_generic H (U * coordinateMatrix I)
      g y α hH (transformed_coordinateMatrix_injective U hUL I) hα hq hβ
  have hgram :
      (∑ I ∈ S, (metricGram H (Matrix.fromCols (Matrix.replicateCol Unit y)
        (U * coordinateMatrix I))).det) ≤ sqNorm y * principalSum H (j + 1) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ I ∈ S, (metricGram (Matrix.diagonal lam)
          (Matrix.fromCols (Matrix.replicateCol Unit (Uᵀ.mulVec y))
            (coordinateMatrix I))).det := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro I _
        rw [metricGram_append_orthogonal H U hUR y, hdiag]
      _ ≤ sqNorm (Uᵀ.mulVec y) * principalSum (Matrix.diagonal lam) (j + 1) :=
        diagonal_coordinate_gram_sum_le lam hlam (Uᵀ.mulVec y) j
      _ = sqNorm y * principalSum H (j + 1) := by
        rw [sqNorm_orthogonal_coordinates U hUR y, ← hdiag,
          principalSum_conjugate Uᵀ U H hUL]
  change principalSum Hplus j ≤
    sqNorm y / (β ^ 2 * q) * principalSum H (j + 1) + α / β * principalSum H j
  calc
    principalSum Hplus j = ∑ I ∈ S, (metricGram Hplus (U * coordinateMatrix I)).det :=
      (sum_transformed_coordinate_grams Hplus U hUL j).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ I ∈ S,
        ((metricGram H (Matrix.fromCols (Matrix.replicateCol Unit y)
          (U * coordinateMatrix I))).det / (β ^ 2 * q) +
        α / β * (metricGram H (U * coordinateMatrix I)).det) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun I _ => hpoint I)
    _ = (∑ I ∈ S, (metricGram H (Matrix.fromCols (Matrix.replicateCol Unit y)
          (U * coordinateMatrix I))).det) / (β ^ 2 * q) + α / β * principalSum H j := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [show (∑ I ∈ S, (metricGram H (U * coordinateMatrix I)).det) =
        principalSum H j from sum_transformed_coordinate_grams H U hUL j]
    _ ≤ (sqNorm y * principalSum H (j + 1)) / (β ^ 2 * q) +
        α / β * principalSum H j := by
      exact add_le_add_right (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hgram (by positivity)) _
    _ = sqNorm y / (β ^ 2 * q) * principalSum H (j + 1) + α / β * principalSum H j := by
      ring
